name: Soshite Hatsukoi ga Imouto ni Naru
original_name: そして初恋が妹になる
source:
Having faced many hardships as a child, the cynical Kazuharu believed that the world was a wasteland and the only way to survive it was to work your hardest. There’s no time for playing nor falling in love, like the rest of his classmates.

While he was working hard as usual, he saw a mysterious girl with a uniform he did not recognize. She appeared to always avoid the gaze of others. Normally he wouldn’t pay much attention, but for some reason he was particularly interested in her. Then suddenly one day, she became his imouto.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
童年经历过许多磨难的一春，愤世嫉俗的他认为世界是一片荒原，生存的唯一出路就是尽自己最大的努力。没有时间玩耍，也没有时间谈恋爱，就像他的其他同学一样。

当他像往常一样努力工作时，他看到了一个穿着他不认识的制服的神秘女孩。她似乎总是回避别人的目光。平时他不会太在意，但不知为什么，他对她特别感兴趣。然后突然有一天，她成了他的妹妹。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
